g.text: Annual education spending per student (log scale)
Half of rural Sindh students cost their family under Rs 4,500 a year; the top tenth, over Rs 15,500
Source: PSLM 2019-20, person file. Sample: students (ed_total > 0) in rural Sindh, n = 1440. Weighted by hhweight. 1 student(s) outside Rs 100 to Rs 1,000,000 excluded from the histogram.
